meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (Unitary national jurisdiction; Metropolitan and Overseas departments)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L. 561-1 through L. 561-50 and R. 561-1 through R. 561-69 (AML/CFT obligations transposing Directives (EU) 2015/849 and (EU) 2018/843); CMF Article L. 561-2-2 and Decree No. 2016-1572 of 22 November 2016 (mandatory declaration of the registre des bénéficiaires effectifs, filed with the Greffe together with the RNE/RCS application); Code de commerce, Articles L. 123-1 et seq. (company and beneficial owner registers); CMF Article L. 561-15 (suspicious transaction reporting to TRACFIN); CMF Articles L. 562-1 through L. 562-12 (national enforcement of UN, EU and domestic financial sanctions including DG Trésor asset-freeze orders); CNIL data protection rules applying to the processing of identity data. Access regime: following CJEU joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 and Decree No. 2024-823 of 19 July 2024, the French UBO register is not openly public; access is limited to competent authorities (TRACFIN, DGFIP, DGCCRF, AMF), AML-obliged entities acting within their statutory duties, and persons with a demonstrated legitimate interest.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation (existence certificate) of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or secretary of state of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague apostille certificate (Convention of 5 October 1961, France in force since 24 January 1965) followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or compliance certificate of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry or tax authority of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague apostille certificate plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the SARL, the capital contribution and the appointment of representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or notary of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague apostille certificate plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport bio-data page of each beneficial owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague apostille certificate or notarized certified copy (per receiving bank and Greffe requirements) plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement issued within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or bank of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague apostille certificate plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of the complete packet (traduction assermentée)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator registered with a French Cour d'appel (traducteur assermenté)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Court-of-appeal certification; no apostille applies to the translation itself, which must be attached to the apostilled originals

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, managers, and authorized signatories prior to filing and prior to bank onboarding: (1) PEP classification under CMF Article L. 561-10 transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849; (2) TRACFIN typologies and FIU indicators; (3) national asset-freeze decisions under CMF Articles L. 562-1 to L. 562-12 (DG Trésor); (4) EU consolidated sanctions list, Council Regulations (EU) No. 269/2014 and No. 833/2014; (5) OFAC SDN and consolidated non-SDN lists; (6) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions; (7) FATF high-risk jurisdiction list. Screening results must be documented with an audit trail, risk rating, and date of verification; a positive match triggers immediate freezing under CMF Article L. 562-2 and a suspicious transaction report to TRACFIN under CMF Article L. 561-15.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet électronique des formalités d'entreprises (formalities.entreprises.gouv.fr) and Infogreffe (infogreffe.fr); public availability check through the official RNE/INPI database at data.inpi.fr and annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be written in Latin alphabetical characters; accented French characters are permitted. French law does not impose a French-language name, but the chosen name must be available, not misleading, compliant with public order and good morals, and compatible with the dematerialized RNE/INPI acceptance system. A foreign-language name should be accompanied by a certified French translation for the by-laws and the legal announcement publication if required by the Greffe.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France operates no formal pre-incorporation name reservation; the Greffe verifies the name at filing, and the 30-day window is an operational convention rather than a statutory period. Procedure upon refusal: (1) within 8 days request a written statement of reasons identifying the exact ground (public order, misleading denomination, protected term, or prior rights); (2) if the conflict arises from an existing corporate name or trademark, obtain a written waiver from the rights holder or amend the name and re-file a complete incorporation dossier via the Guichet électronique / Infogreffe; (3) if the refusal is maintained, petition the tribunal de commerce (juge chargé de la direction des services de greffe) within 15 days of notification on grounds of disproportionality; (4) where the refusal rests on a ministerial protected denomination, pursue administrative recourse before the competent administrative court; (5) after 30 days without incorporation, repeat the name-availability search and, where relevant, the INPI trademark pre-search.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this industry. An SARL carrying on ISIC 7310 digital media buying and affiliate lead generation is not a regulated activity requiring physical premises. The registered office may be established at the manager's French residence or with a licensed business-domiciliation company under Code de commerce Article L. 123-11-2; the initial domiciliation agreement is limited to five years for a new enterprise and is renewable. Commercial substance is evidenced by actual management seats, bank transaction flow, contracts with advertising partners, and ongoing operating expenses rather than by physical premises.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 5-15% likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection during the first three years for a non-regulated digital advertising SARL. The Greffe rarely conducts unilateral on-site checks; the main exposure arises from DGFIP tax audits and URSSAF inspections, and a suspicious transaction report to TRACFIN or anomalous UBO or domiciliation patterns would raise the likelihood to approximately 40-50%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of greffe emoluments and registration duties set by ministerial decree

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice in a Journal d'annonces légales (legal announcement journal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for a standard SARL announcement (EUR 130-200)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business domiciliation agreement for the registered office (siège social), first 12 months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed business-domiciliation company under Article L. 123-11-2 Code de commerce

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague apostille legalization of foreign shareholder and UBO documents (3 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of each document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per apostille; international practice band USD 20-40 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified French translation of the apostilled document packet (traduction assermentée)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator registered with a French Cour d'appel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory scale of court-registered expert translators; market band EUR 300-500

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and INPI trademark conflict pre-search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for availability and collision search

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC concierge for target payment rails (Mercury ACH, Wire Transfer, Wise), including corporate bank and fintech onboarding support

Contingency reserve: re-filing upon name rejection, supplementary apostilles or translations, and second JAL publication if required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prudent 4-5% of total budget based on market rates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II — Article L. 223-1 through L. 223-43 (constitution, operation, and capital of a SARL); Articles L. 123-1 et seq. (registration in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); Loi n° 2019-486 (PACTE) and Guichet Unique implementing regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) maintained by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for the registered office; filings are made electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) accompanied by the statutory Déclaration de création d'une société (standard form Cerfa n° 13967*02, formerly M0), transmitted via the Guichet Unique to the RCS.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital: L. 223-2 C. com. leaves the capital amount to the articles, and EUR 1 is lawful. At least 20% of in-cash subscriptions must be paid up before filing for registration (L. 223-7 C. com.); funds must be deposited in a blocked bank account or notarial escrow before signature of the statuts, and the balance is payable within 5 years. The blocked funds are released only upon presentation of the Kbis extract.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE SOCIÉTÉ À RESPONSABILITÉ LIMITÉE [NAME], FRANCE. RESOLVED, that the shareholders approve the Articles of Association as signed and adopt the registered office at [Address], France. RESOLVED, that the shareholders acknowledge the deposit of the share capital in the blocked account and declare that the cash subscriptions are subscribed and paid at least to the legal minimum per Article L. 223-7 of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed Gérant for the full legal term with the broadest powers to manage the Company and to open bank accounts, sign contracts, and hire staff. RESOLVED, that all formation filings (RCS, Guichet Unique, legal notices) are authorized and the Kbis may be requested accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts) and preliminary documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private drafting; a notary (notaire) is required only for real-property contributions or subsequent transfers of buildings; otherwise the statuts may be executed under private signature with electronic signatures.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in French, defining the corporate form (SARL), company name, registered office address, corporate object covering digital advertising arbitrage, affiliate media buying and lead generation, duration (up to 99 years), share capital, distribution of parts sociales, appointment of the Gérant, and decision-making rules. All founding associates must initial and sign every page; if real estate is contributed, the deed must be notarized and annexed to the statuts.
required_dossiers: Certified copies of identity documents of all associates
Proof of residence of each associate
Draft and final signed versions of the Statuts
Draft beneficial-owner declaration (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
Declaration on honour of non-conviction for the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or any partner raises objections, amend the specific clauses, re-issue signature pages, and obtain fresh initials from all associates; no court intervention is required for standard corrections to the draft.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked capital deposit and issuance of the attestation de dépôt de fonds
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed credit institution chosen by the founders, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or the notary holding funds in escrow.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the société en formation by presenting the draft statuts and KYC/AML documentation; transfer the subscribed cash (at least 20% of cash contributions, i.e., a minimum of EUR 0.20 for a EUR 1 nominal capital, though in practice founders contribute higher amounts); obtain an unqualified capital-deposit certificate stating the amount and that funds are blocked until the Kbis is delivered.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts
KYC/AML documents of each associate and the Gérant (passports, proof of address, source of funds)
Bank account mandate for the account opened on behalf of the company in formation
Transfer order and proof of the deposited amount
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the file under internal AML rules given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier, supplement the source-of-funds documentation, present the business plan, and either proceed with the same bank or select an alternative licensed bank; the final certificate must be unconditional for RCS purposes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation notice (avis de constitution) in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized by the prefecture for the department of the registered office, as listed by the Direction de l'information légale et administrative.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the text of the incorporation notice containing the corporate form (SARL), company name, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, identity of the Gérant, and the RCS court location; the JAL publishes the notice and issues the attestation de parution, normally within 1 to 3 business days; publication must occur before or simultaneously with the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Avis de constitution text
Draft Statuts for verification by the JAL
Identity details of the legal representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requests clarification or identifies incomplete statutory content, correct the legal wording, have the text validated by the drafting counsel or notary, and re-submit for publication; publication cannot be waived.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of the creation dossier via the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI — Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitting the dossier to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, and URSSAF.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Connect with FranceConnect or a dedicated account, complete the online creation declaration replicating the Cerfa n° 13967*02 fields, attach all supporting documents, declare the beneficial owners, and submit; the platform issues an acknowledgement of receipt and tracks the file until delivery to the registries.
required_dossiers: Signed Statuts
Capital deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds)
JAL publication attestation
Proof of authorized use of the registered office (lease, domiciliation contract, or owner consent)
List of beneficial owners (DBE)
Declaration on honour of non-conviction for the Gérant
Identity documents of associates and the Gérant
Recommended INPI trademark search certificate for the company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffier issues an observation or refusal notification for incompleteness, the filer must respond within 15 calendar days through the Guichet Unique by uploading the missing document or correcting the declaration; a total refusal may be challenged before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce in accordance with Article L. 123-5 C. com.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, INSEE number allocation and Kbis issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) in coordination with INSEE (SIRENE database).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following legal conformity review, the greffier inscribes the company in the RCS and issues the extract Kbis; INSEE allocates the SIREN, SIRET, and APE code (7310Z — Advertising). Upon presentation of the Kbis, the bank releases the blocked capital, and the company acquires full legal capacity; the Gérant then completes any remaining declarations required by the social and tax authorities.
required_dossiers: No new documents — the greffier verifies the complete file transmitted by the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is not issued within the statutory timeframe of approximately 5 working days after a complete filing, submit a reminder through the Guichet Unique and, if necessary, apply to the President of the Tribunal de Commerce in summary proceedings for an injunction; a registrar's refusal may be appealed under the rules of the Code de commerce.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — ISIC 7310 digital advertising and media-buying is a non-manufacturing service activity; no industrial licensing body intervenes. For workplace and labour oversight, the competent authority is DREETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — the activity is not subject to a licence d'exploitation; the RCS registration (Kbis) constitutes the operating authorization. Sectoral compliance applies, notably the RGPD/CNIL data-protection regime, the LCEN provisions for digital services, and the consumer-protection rules of the Code de la consommation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecological Transition — French Environmental Code (Code de l'environnement), with ICPE inspection services of the DREAL/DRIEAT in the region.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — digital advertising is an office-based service not listed in the ICPE nomenclature (Code de l'environnement, installational classifications annex); no environmental impact assessment under Article R. 122-2 is triggered, and no prior authorisation or registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge, VOC, or wastewater thresholds attach to the activity. General obligations apply: office wastewater must meet municipal sewer pre-treatment rules; electrical and electronic equipment waste must be managed under the DEEE take-back (REP) regime; indoor workplace air must comply with the occupational exposure limit values of the Code du travail (R. 4222-1 et seq.).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: if the premises are open to the public, the office must be classified as an ERP under the Code de la construction with a fire-commission visit for 5th-category establishments; employee-only offices must comply with Code du travail fire and evacuation rules (R. 4227-1 et seq.) and obtain an electrical-installation conformity certificate (Consuel). Occupational clearance: declare the first hire through the DUE (URSSAF), display the mandatory labour notices, provide access to workplace medical services, and maintain the premises in compliance with the Code du travail workplace health and safety standards; structural-load inspection applies only if the building dossier so requires, which is standard office use and not physically demanding.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) under the Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique; tax administration portal: www.impots.gouv.fr; business formalities portal (Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises): formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (operated by INPI); dedicated non-established taxpayers unit: Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE), DGFiP, 10 rue du Centre, 93160 Noisy-le-Grand.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Determine whether the foreign entity has a fixed establishment (établissement stable) in France; if yes, register the establishment through the Guichet Unique portal at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, after which INSEE assigns the SIREN/SIRET identifiers and DGFiP automatically issues the French intra-community VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire, format FR + 11 characters). Step 2: If there is no fixed establishment but taxable supplies or reverse-charge acquisitions arise in France, the foreign entity applies directly to the DGFiP/SIEE for a French VAT number without a SIRET, submitting certified statutes, current registration extract or equivalent company register certificate from the State of residence, proof of address and legal representative identity, and a statement of the expected first taxable transaction date and nature. Step 3: The SIEE cross-checks the applicant's establishment via VIES/foreign registries and issues the VAT number. Step 4: Open the professional tax account (espace professionnel) on impots.gouv.fr, register for the CA3/CA12 VAT filing cycle, and comply with Intrastat/e-reporting obligations. All TIN disclosures on invoices and registries must use the single French VAT number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation with limited Pass_Through_Eligible; Territorial_Scope; Tax_Exempt_Zone not applicable. A French SARL is opaque by default and subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS) at the entity level (Art. 206-1 CGI); the standard CIT rate is 25%, with a reduced 15% rate on taxable profits up to EUR 42,500 for eligible SMEs below EUR 10 million turnover (Art. 219-I-b CGI). Only qualifying family SARLs may elect income-tax transparency (Art. 239 bis AA CGI). French CIT applies to profits attributable to enterprises operated in France only (territoriality, Art. 209-I CGI); foreign branch profits of the SARL are generally exempt from French CIT unless profits are artificially channelled back to France. No tax-exempt zone status applies to a digital media buying entity in metropolitan France.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no check-the-box regime; entity classification is governed by law and the place of effective management. Available elections: (i) option for IR pass-through treatment for family SARLs (Art. 239 bis AA CGI); (ii) option for fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) for French-resident companies held at least 95% (Art. 223 A CGI); (iii) opt-in to the parent-subsidiary participation exemption at the 5% holding threshold (Art. 145 CGI); (iv) SME election for the reduced 15% CIT rate on the first EUR 42,500 of profit (Art. 219-I-b CGI); (v) election to renounce the small-business VAT exemption (Art. 293 B CGI); (vi) no hybrid-mismatch election exists: ATAD anti-hybrid rules (EU Directive 2016/1164, transposed under Art. 212 bis CGI) are mandatory and override mismatching payee/payor treatments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible Euro currency regime aligned with EU liberalization rules. Capital account transactions require no prior authorization and are subject only to post-transaction reporting to the Banque de France via the central securities depository. Profit remittances to foreign shareholders are unrestricted subject to French tax withholding at source where applicable and full AML/KYC compliance enforced by Tracfin. Primary hurdles include verification of beneficial ownership, source of funds documentation, and alignment with anti-tax-evasion standards under the OECD BEPS framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For physical goods exports, proceeds must be surrendered to a French bank within 60 days of receipt and converted at the official rate if required under customs valuation. For digital services and affiliate media buying transactions, no surrender obligation applies; funds may be retained in offshore accounts with supporting invoices, performance contracts, and tax declaration to the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise and Mercury are operationally viable for cross-border affiliate payments but require mandatory linkage to a French licensed bank account for regulatory compliance. Direct issuance of French fintech EMIs is restricted under AMF and EBA licensing; offshore platforms must comply with French data localization and reporting obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding is permitted for French SARL entities via qualified e-KYC platforms. Directors and authorized signatories must submit valid government-issued ID and may be required to complete a video KYC interview or in-person verification when transaction volumes exceed €50,000 monthly or when risk scoring flags enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds from high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed source of wealth statement, beneficial ownership certificate (BOC), corporate charter, and audited financial statements demonstrating legitimate affiliate media buying revenue
Client contracts, performance-based payment proofs, tax compliance filings, and bank reference letters to substantiate commercial purpose

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQTY'. Verification requires full KYC package, beneficial ownership declaration, RCS registration extract, and shareholder resolution. All wires must reference the exact entity name and purpose code to avoid rejection by French correspondent banks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for affiliate disbursements. Commercial Letters of Credit may be utilized for structured trade settlements. All outbound payments require supporting documentation including affiliate contracts, performance reports, and tax invoices. Purpose codes must reflect 'service payment' or 'media buying' to satisfy French banking compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Legal Situation (Confirmation d’activité – annual return to RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via Infogreffe; INPI national register (RNCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within two (2) months following each anniversary of the SARL’s RCS registration date; every calendar year without exception.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registrar formal notice; failure to correct within statutory response period leads to reasoned strike-off from the RCS, loss of legal personality until restoration; the registry may additionally apply financial penalty per Articles L.123-5, R.123-10 C. com.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Verification and Declaration (Déclaration des Bénéficiaires Effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (transmitted via the annual RCS confirmation or separate modified declaration duly updated)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Data confirmed at the RCS anniversary; any change of beneficial ownership (share transfer, control shift) must be filed within sixty (60) days in a separate UBO declaration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 for individuals and EUR 37,500 for legal entities; deliberate concealment may additionally expose responsible officers to imprisonment up to six months; repeated default aggravates strike-off risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Financial Statements (Dépôt des Comptes Annuels au Greffe)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Infogreffe central filing service)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than one (1) month after the annual shareholders’ meeting approving the accounts; the meeting itself must approve the accounts within six (6) months of the financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil financial penalty of EUR 450 per non-filed dossier (Art. R. 232-10 et seq. C. com.); possible court injunction with daily ‘astreinte’ (penalty payment); managing director (gérant) exposed to statutory fines; persistent default triggers removal from RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Déclaration de Résultats – CERFA 2065) and IS instalment/balance payment schedule (CERFA 2572)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) territorial office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year ending 31 December: electronic return due by May 3 of the following year; non-calendar fiscal year: return due on the 28th day of the third month following the fiscal year close; balance payment due at filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest (intérêts de retard); 10% penalty for late filing, increased to 40% in fraud or deliberate concealment scenarios; failure to remit the balance may activate tax lien enforcement by DGFiP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting – Ordinary Shareholders’ Approval of Annual Accounts (AGOA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate minute book (not filed; approved accounts recorded with the Greffe without separate fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting must be convened and accounts approved within six (6) months following the financial year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The gérant who fails to obtain shareholder approval loses the benefit of release from internal liability; any shareholder may petition the court to order the meeting (tribunal judiciaire); deliberate evasion may carry criminal fine under Article L.241-9 C. com.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of statutory auditor for French SARL when two of the three thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: total balance sheet assets above EUR 6M; turnover (ex-VAT) above EUR 12M; average payroll headcount above 50. Audit is also mandatory for any entity controlling or controlled by an audit-required company; groups appoint a group auditor even if the SARL itself remains below the individual thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général and ANC regulations) is the sole statutory accounting framework for SARL annual separate financial statements; IFRS is available only at optional consolidated level of listed securities groups. The fiscal result is the accounting net result adjusted by tax restatements and integrated into the CERFA 2065 series filed with DGFiP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year at the time of the annual RCS confirmation, the SARL must declare that the UBO data held by the registry remains accurate; every change in shareholding—whether a full transfer of quota or a change in effective control—shall be declared within sixty (60) days via an amended UBO form, with the same registration fee and sanctions structure. The gérant bears the duty to identify and register direct and indirect individuals holding more than 25% of quota or voting rights; mere failure to update does not extinguish the obligation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Movements of Securities (Registre des mouvements de titres / feuille de présence)
Register of Shareholders’ Resolutions and Minutes (Registre des procès-verbaux d’assemblées)
Register of Managerial Decisions (Registre des décisions du gérant)
Optional but advised: Register of Beneficial Owners (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 2,000 per year (EUR 350 – 1,850) for a registered office/agent in Ile-de-France or provincial flexible office provider inclusive of mail handling and administrative support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – 10,000 (EUR 3,500 – 9,200) typified for a small to mid-size SARL performing media buying, assuming a clean ledger and a sole auditor; quotations trend upward if the affiliate network operates through multi-entity flows.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate, fiscal years commencing on or after 1 January 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit per fiscal year (SME conditions: turnover < EUR 10M, fully paid-up share capital, ≥75% held by individuals). Full-rate tax on excess at 25%. A 3.3% social contribution (contribution sociale sur l'IS) applies when IS due exceeds EUR 763,000 and group turnover ≥ EUR 7,630,000. Digital/advertising media buying benefits from no sector-specific incentive; R&D tax credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D expenses if ad-tech software qualifies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite carryforward (offre de report en avant) with an annual offset cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; one-year carryback (report en arrière) capped at EUR 1,000,000 and refundable over five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual corporate income tax return: 'Liasse fiscale' — form n° 2065-SD (CERFA 15938) plus supporting schedules 2050-SD through 2058-SD; filed electronically using the EFI/EDI-TDFC module of the official portal impots.gouv.fr (Espace professionnel).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (plus separate quarterly advance-payment declarations, see below).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year ending 31 December: file by the second business day after 1 May (normally 3 May; extended if that date is a non-business day). Fiscal year ending on another date: file within three months of the fiscal year-end. Quarterly IS installments (acomptes) due 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December; final balance due with the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the SARL, SIREN registration number, registered office address, and place of management in France.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident company's French permanent establishment (PE), enter the PE's French address and the foreign head-office registration number; the PE is taxed at IS rates on its French-attributable profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business activity description and the French NAF/APE activity code (for media buying and affiliate lead generation use 73.11Z or 73.12Z as applicable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the PE's actual corporate purpose and the activity code of the French branch; do not list the foreign parent's non-French activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Indication of the applicable regime: for a disposition taxed at entity level, tick the corporate income tax (IS) box — relevant where the SARL has opted for IS (default for SARL is income tax if the company is not opting for IS, but entity-level taxation applies for eligible options or commercial forms).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PE of a foreign entity is always subject to IS without an option; complete the IS box and provide the head-office tax identification.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit or deductible deficit determined after the re-additions and deductions carried out on the 2058-A schedule (including non-deductible expenses, depreciation, provisions, and directors' fees).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the profit attributable to the French PE and computed by reference to the relevant DTA provisions should be entered; profits of the foreign head office are excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of transactions with related enterprises and transfer prices (loaned funds, commissions, media-buying margins payable to non-resident affiliates).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the documentation threshold is met, complete the supplementary transfer-pricing statement (form 2257-SD); otherwise, keep contemporaneous arm's length documentation for audit defense.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of French tax credits, principally the research tax credit (CIR) for qualifying software R&D and other recoverable withholding taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PEs may claim credits only for expenses attributable to the PE; foreign tax credits on income taxed abroad are claimed by the head office, not by the PE.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty (Article 1728 CGI): 10% of the net tax due (return filed within 30 days of the deadline), 40% where filed after 30 days following the first formal notice, 80% in cases of fraudulent maneuvers or abuse of law. Late payment interest (Article 1727 CGI) accrues at 0.20% per month. Ex officio assessment is possible if no return is filed within 60 days of the deadline; electronic-filing non-compliance may trigger an additional EUR 15 per filing incident. Quarterly installment defaults carry the same scale on the unpaid installments.
